# T3 WhatsApp

> A local WhatsApp companion for T3 Code, using the owner's own account.

- [Installation](INSTALL.md): Download and dependency installation; hands off to the setup skill.
- [Setup skill](skills/t3-whatsapp-setup/SKILL.md): Diagnostics, setup UI launch, configuration, and live verification.
- [Usage](README.md): Setup prompt and WhatsApp command examples.
- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md): History, project hints, delivery, and operational constraints.
- [Project instructions](AGENTS.md): Repository contribution and safety invariants.
